text:
elaine: Heads-up PR #4882 updates the migration guide and SDK snippet for routing flags. Aiming to merge before the v1.4.2 docs freeze (2026-03-22 16:00 PT). Need 2 approvals + preview green. Can @omar or @sophia take a look?

docs-ci-bot: Preview build started for PR #4882 (lint, linkcheck, build).

omar: I can review in ~30. One thing: show both header and client config ways to enable the flag; and include a short note about versioned paths so customers on Private know where to find it.

esophia: I'll check the SDK snippet. Also please put the file in `/docs/versions/1.4.2/migrate-routing.md` so it lands under the release docs.

elaine: done: added header + client config examples, moved file to versions/1.4.2. Preview will be posted.

docs-ci-bot: Preview ready: https://docs-preview.internal/preview/4882  checks: lint \u2705, linkcheck \u2705, build \u2705.

omar: quick pass: minor rename suggestion: use `routing_hint` instead of `routeHint` for consistency. Not blocking. Approved.

esophia: approved after small edit to batch example (use `batch_create()` API).

release-bot: Release note: v1.4.2 freeze at 2026-03-22T23:00Z. Ops request: toggle `new-routing` in canary by 10:00 PT so smoke tests cover it.

elaine: will hold merge until canary flag is ON and smoke tests pass. Please shout if ops can't make the toggle window.

release-bot: `new-routing` toggled ON in us-west-2 canary at 2026-03-22T10:02Z.

elaine: canary smoke tests passed at 10:18 PT. Merging now and tagging PR with release-note: "docs: routing flags migration + SDK v2 examples (v1.4.2)"

omar: thanks  noted the variable rename follow-up.

esophia: :shipit: merged.
